title: Riptide
description: The «Riptide» spell now officially works without requiring water or rain, and without the need for crooked crutches, featuring recognizable animations.
body:
This plugin lets you fly using the Trident with the Riptide enchantment. Unlike other plugins I found online, which had many flaws and didn’t allow you to hold down the Trident to use the original animation, this one does: This plugin fixes that problem, and you can fly without water or rain!

I haven’t seen anything like it because they’re usually really hard to implement, and just to make it simple, but I made this for you with all my heart!

In config.yml, you can switch between Russian and English, and enable Mojang's auto-translation, depending on the client's language.

The config.yml settings themselves:
language: auto  — Auto (Translate automatically depending on the client language, both for the Trident and the book)
ru — Russian,
eng (or english) — English,
Do not translate: false/none.

Plugin info (extended):
Located at: plugins/Riptide
Version plugin: 1.21.3
